earth.title: Nuugaatsiaq, Greenland

grid.crs: EPSG:3413 · WGS84 / NSIDC Polar Stereographic North

earth.origin: Stereo-derived surface heights. The supplied matchtag separately identifies stereo-matched (1) and interpolated (0) cells; it does not identify donor heights or establish accuracy.
earth.productionMethod: SETSM stereo reconstruction; native 2 m strip samples
earth.productionScope: 500 × 500 m native crop; DSM includes buildings and other surface objects, not guaranteed bare earth.
earth.quality: Supplied edge/water/cloud bitmask and separate stereo matchtag; categorical indicators, not numerical uncertainty.
earth.history: Image acquisition 19 June 2017; constituent scenes processed in 2018, strip created 7 November 2021, generated 9 June 2022 and published 19 October 2022. This product is not established as available during the 2017 response.
earth.credit: Polar Geospatial Center / ArcticDEM · Porter et al. (2022)

metadata.scope: Supplied categorical evidence; zero mask is not a guarantee of accuracy.
metadata.timing: 19 June 2017, 18:25:50–18:26:36 UTC imagery. Present product availability does not establish 2017 operational availability.
metadata.nativeGrid: 250 × 250 cells at native 2 m posting; Hallmark crop applies no resampling, smoothing, filling or vertical offset; upstream SETSM smoothing remains part of the source product.
metadata.endpointStatus: Hallmark-selected illustrative endpoints on the southern settlement peninsula. Checked against published settlement aerial/topographic maps (Strzelecki & Jaskólski 2020, figures 1 and 3) and the downloaded OpenStreetMap coastline context (5 November 2026). These are not a documented rescue route, surveyed clearance, road-following constraint or rover capability claim.
metadata.sourceNoData: DEM −9999; all 62,500 crop heights finite. Mask value 1 is an edge bit; matchtag 0 is retained as interpolated evidence.

contextPhoto.credit: Shizuoka Point Cloud Support Team / CrisisMappers Japan

ground.label: 5–6 July · Ground lidar

grid.crs: LAS CRS omitted; Japanese Plane Rectangular CS VIII (EPSG:6676) assumed for alignment to the DSM

ground.productionMethod: Hallmark median gridding of the released July 5–6 ground-filtered LAS points
ground.productionScope: Retrospective 1 m crop derived for the prototype
ground.credit: Windy Network · Shizuoka Prefecture open data
ground.datum: Metres; vertical datum not specified in the LAS archive
ground.origin: Hallmark records the median and number of ground lidar returns in each 1 m square. Zero returns leave a missing height. Per-cell height uncertainty was not supplied.
ground.quality: Ground-return support counts computed from the released ground-filtered point cloud; no per-cell accuracy supplied.
ground.history: Hallmark retrospectively bins the released July 5–6 ground-filtered LAS points into 1 m squares and uses each occupied cell’s median height. Empty bins remain missing (NaN); no elevations are filled. Counts are the number of source points in each square, not an accuracy estimate.

metadata.colour: Mean of the supplied RGB channels of the ground points in each 1 m cell. Cells with zero returns have no measured colour.
metadata.pointSupport: Per-cell counts are computed from the released ground-filtered points. They describe this later survey’s local support only.
metadata.gridding: Hallmark median of source ground-point elevations per 1 m square; west/south edges included, east/north edges excluded.
metadata.crsStatus: The LAS header contains no CRS record. EPSG:6676 is an explicit co-registration assumption based on coordinate overlap with the georeferenced DSM, not a verified LAS CRS.
metadata.sourceLicense: CC BY 4.0 / ODbL as stated by the Shizuoka Prefecture publisher.
metadata.missingValues: Cells with no ground points are NaN; no interpolation or gap filling.

proposalSource.credit: Shizuoka Point Cloud Support Team · distributed by CrisisMappers Japan
proposalSource.method: Median of finite 0.10 m DSM pixel-centre samples whose centres fall inside each 1 m square; NoData pixels are excluded and empty cells remain NaN.
proposalSource.surface: DSM includes vegetation and objects; it is a separate earlier survey and is not the July 5–6 ground model.
proposalSource.sourceLicense: CC BY 4.0 / ODbL as stated by the publisher.
proposalSource.crs: EPSG:6676, JGD2011 / Japan Plane Rectangular CS VIII, as declared in the DSM GeoTIFF.
proposalSource.registration: The LAS header omits CRS. Shared local coordinates are assumed for alignment based on the documented overlap; LAS CRS is not verified.
proposalSource.history: Independent reconstruction from 3 July footage; DSM resource registered 5 July. Same-day availability to responders is unverified. This legacy proposal layer is retained as separate-survey context and does not fill missing ground-lidar cells.

july3-dsm.label: 3 July · Video surface

grid.crs: EPSG:6676 · JGD2011 / Japan Plane Rectangular CS VIII (declared by source DSM)

july3-dsm.productionMethod: Hallmark median aggregation of valid 10 cm source DSM pixel-centre samples into 1 m squares
july3-dsm.productionScope: Retrospective 125 × 125 m crop of the independent 3 July DSM
july3-dsm.credit: Shizuoka Point Cloud Support Team · distributed by CrisisMappers Japan
july3-dsm.datum: Metres; vertical datum not specified in the cited DSM source metadata
july3-dsm.origin: Hallmark retains the median of valid source DSM pixel-centre elevations in each 1 m square. The source reconstruction ancestry and per-cell uncertainty are not supplied. Valid source-pixel counts describe aggregation inputs, not lidar returns or accuracy.
july3-dsm.quality: No source per-cell quality mask or accuracy estimate supplied. DSM sample counts only count valid aggregation inputs.
july3-dsm.history: Independent reconstruction from footage captured 3 July 2021; DSM resource registered 5 July. Same-day availability to responders is unverified. Hallmark aggregates the retained source DSM samples without filling, smoothing or importing lidar heights. This DSM includes surface objects and vegetation; it is not a ground model. Native gaps remain NaN.

metadata.colour: 3 July orthophoto JPEG pixel containing each 1 m cell centre. These independent display colours do not add height measurements or identify land cover; no lidar RGB is used.
metadata.dsmSampleSupport: Counts of finite, non-NoData 10 cm source DSM pixel centres in each 1 m square. They do not measure source image support, accuracy or per-cell uncertainty.
metadata.gridding: Median of finite, non-NoData source DSM pixel-centre samples in each 1 m square; west/south edges included, east/north edges excluded. Source NoData is -32767.
metadata.sourceResolution: 0.10 m source DSM pixel spacing; 1 m output aggregation grid.
metadata.sourceOrigin: Source pixel-corner origin E 52046.98237225347, N -97220.5039069222; signed pixel spacing 0.10000000000000198, -0.10000000000000192 m; retained window starts at source column 530, row 5.
metadata.crsStatus: The source DSM declares EPSG:6676. The companion LAS omits CRS; same-location comparison assumes its shared local coordinates align with the DSM and does not verify that alignment.
metadata.sourceLicense: CC BY 4.0 / ODbL as stated by publisher
metadata.missingValues: No valid source DSM samples means NaN and zero sample count; no interpolation or gap filling.
metadata.timing: Drone footage captured 3 July 2021; DSM resource registered 5 July. Same-day availability to responders unverified.

blatten.title: Tennmatten, Blatten, Switzerland
blatten.productionMethod: Exact native 2 m samples cropped from two standard swissALTI3D tiles
blatten.productionScope: 400 × 400 m pre-collapse baseline; no post-event deposit heights
blatten.origin: Native production grid samples; underlying survey dependencies and per-cell uncertainty are not supplied in this fixture.
blatten.quality: No per-cell quality or survey support mask supplied. All 40,000 crop cells have finite source elevations.
blatten.history: The 2024 archive edition precedes the 28 May 2025 collapse. Hallmark concatenates adjoining native grid windows without resampling, smoothing, interpolation or gap filling. The year is the product edition, not a verified survey date.

metadata.sourceLicense: Standard swisstopo open government data: use, distribution, processing and commercial use permitted with attribution. Not a Rapid Mapping product or derivative.
metadata.eventRelation: Pre-collapse baseline, before the 28 May 2025 Blatten collapse. Does not represent the deposit or current traversability.
metadata.missingValues: No NoData cells in this crop; missing source cells would remain missing.
metadata.nativeGrid: 200 × 200 native 2 m samples, row-major north to south, west to east.
metadata.endpointStatus: Illustrative inspection endpoints chosen for demonstration, not sourced responder positions or a validated rescue route.

post-event.productionMethod: Metashape reconstruction from 30 May oblique aerial photographs
post-event.productionScope: Published 1 m surface raster v2. Hallmark extracts native cells.
post-event.origin: Per-cell stereo matches, interpolation history and accuracy are not supplied.
post-event.quality: No per-cell quality flags or calibrated uncertainty supplied.
post-event.datum: Metres; reconstruction aligned to swissALTI3D, vertical datum not specified in the author’s file.
post-event.credit: Simeon Schmauß - created from BAFU/swisstopo Rapid Mapping oblique imagery, CC BY 4.0. Source: FOEN, swisstopo.
post-event.history: The author georeferenced the reconstruction to swissALTI3D and SWISSIMAGE. Vegetation and structures remain in the surface.

metadata.positionalResidual: 1.6 m average positional error at controls (whole reconstruction)
metadata.missingValues: All 160,000 native elevations in this crop are finite. Coverage does not establish surface stability.
metadata.colour: 30 May federal orthophoto, averaged into each native surface cell for display.
metadata.sourceLicense: CC BY 4.0 · Simeon Schmauß (reconstruction). Source: FOEN, swisstopo (imagery).
metadata.temporalContext: The surface survey supplies no measurement of buried water or load-bearing strength.

moon.title: North of Nassau crater
moon.history: Code 3: suspicious (edge, corner, did not correlate, etc.). Codes 10–14: successful correlation. These categories are not calibrated error probabilities or accuracy guarantees.

connecting-ridge.title: Connecting Ridge
connecting-ridge.product: NASA PGDA 78 · Site01 adjusted 5 m LDEM

grid.crs: MOON_ME / JPL DE421 · lunar south polar stereographic, lon 0°

lolaReturns.derived: LOLA return in {k} of {n} source heights

connecting-ridge.date: Retrieved 5 November 2026; acquisition date not specified
connecting-ridge.credit: NASA / GSFC Planetary Geodynamics Data Archive
connecting-ridge.datum: Delivered surface height Z in metres; no vertical datum transformation performed. Source README does not separately specify vertical reference.
connecting-ridge.origin: Supplier README (PGDA78-README.txt:7), quoted as the supplier's statement: surface height Z "with interpolation filling empty pix". Exact donors and earlier per-cell history are not supplied. LOLA returns per cell is a separate supplier count, not an origin or quality mask.
connecting-ridge.productionMethod: LOLA orbital adjustment and surface interpolation
connecting-ridge.history: Native window only: no reprojection, resampling or scaling. Supplier total Z RMS retained independently of height values; not propagated to derived results or used for planning.

metadata.scope: Supplier height RMS and LOLA returns per cell only; nothing is estimated for derived results
metadata.nativeGrid: Pixel-registered 5 m centres; 256 × 256 native window at source row 1500, col 1300
metadata.heightRMSDefinition: Supplier total height RMS error in metres (PGDA README, toterr layer): the RMS total height error over 100 simulated clones of the LDEM (Barker et al. 2021, Sect. 4). Not propagated to our slope, height spread or illumination; not a probability.
